```{r}

# Installing and loading required packages
# install.packages("tinytex")

library(tinytex)
library(lattice)
library(xtable) # Generating the LaTeX code for tables

```

```{r}

# The figure and table code

# Setting a seed
set.seed(123)

# Creating data
data <- rnorm(1000)

# Plotting a histogram
histogram(data)

# Plotting a density plot
densityplot(data^12 / data^10, xlab = expression(data^12/data^10))

# Plotting a stripplot
stripplot(data^2, xlab = expression(data^2))

# Plotting a boxplot
bwplot(exp(data))

# Creating a matrix with all data used
data.all <- cbind(data = data, 
                  squared1 = data^12 / data^10,
                  squared2 = data^2,
                  exponent = exp(data))

# I now saved the four figures manually

```
